1)
Create a wallet with descriptor using Github username
wallet=$(bitcoin-cli -signet -named createwallet wallet_name="aaron-leeb" descriptors=true)

Export receiving descriptor
bitcoin-cli -signet -rpcwallet=aaron-leeb listdescriptors

2)
Create a native segiwit address using the receiving descriptor
bitcoin-cli -signet -rpcwallet=aaron-leeb deriveaddresses "wpkh([2e4f3516/84h/1h/0h]tpubDCrXi3T2NLjkwHbtD4tQnRDdppzkAaBieQWALZYwhSUk5BipmbcpEwvZGdA7nZGGTAMV9UicgsiFqWpj2igxx9ejJ6Q79B8zXgB6nbGzpam/0/*)#m0cu4u40" "[0,0]"

3)
Fund the address from the faucet
Use listtransactions to find the txid and blockhash of the receive transaction
bitcoin-cli -signet -rpcwallet=aaron-leeb listtransactions

Use getblock to find the coinbase transaction in the block
bitcoin-cli -signet getblock 00000005d768933ec4ef250a768be84e596eebbfe0b9358eab4da3f6a7cea35d 2 | jq -r '.tx[0] | .txid'

4)
Create raw transaction
Get the input information from UTXO (txid and vout)
bitcoin-cli -signet -rpcwallet=aaron-leeb listunspent)

Create a change address
change_address=$(bitcoin-cli -signet -rpcwallet=aaron-leeb getrawchangeaddress)
bitcoin-cli -signet -named -rpcwallet=aaron-leeb createrawtransaction inputs='[{"txid":"28909f7c01eed1d2188dae6a98e4a8b7487bab81eb252c2482fcccdcb07c6a33","vout":1646,"sequence":1}]' outputs='[{"tb1qddpcyus3u603n63lk7m5epjllgexc24vj5ltp7":0.00010000},{"tb1qptc0su508l4tx4k2ugvtyag2zp6mfs4h82dqvv":0.00111264}]'
tx_hex=0200000001336a7cb0dcccfc82242c25eb81ab7b48b7a8e4986aae8d18d2d1ee017c9f90286e06000000010000000210270000000000001600146b43827211e69f19ea3fb7b74c865ffa326c2aaca0b20100000000001600140af0f8728f3feab356cae218b2750a1075b4c2b700000000

Sign the transaction
bitcoin-cli -signet -rpcwallet=aaron-leeb signrawtransactionwithwallet "0200000001336a7cb0dcccfc82242c25eb81ab7b48b7a8e4986aae8d18d2d1ee017c9f90286e06000000010000000210270000000000001600146b43827211e69f19ea3fb7b74c865ffa326c2aaca0b20100000000001600140af0f8728f3feab356cae218b2750a1075b4c2b700000000"

signed_tx_

Broadcast the transaction
bitcoin-cli -signet sendrawtransaction ""

txid=bc774f97a08ffa908cb5148d97341e2f3c19eca733fd03796dced3de1707d30e

Get the block hash of the transaction
bitcoin-cli -signet -rpcwallet=aaron-leeb gettransaction "bc774f97a08ffa908cb5148d97341e2f3c19eca733fd03796dced3de1707d30e"

Use getblock to find the coinbase transaction in the block

bitcoin-cli -signet getblock 00000012434e1b4f4b9bab06678f27ca02d09110649014e504b174fcfdd998d8 2 | jq -r '.tx[0] | .txid'

5) Create 3 new legacy addresses and retrieve their public keys
bitcoin-cli -signet -rpcwallet=aaron-leeb getnewaddress "" legacy

bitcoin-cli -signet -rpcwallet=aaron-leeb getaddressinfo "address"
pubkey1=020965eff1b66b3eb19dc070c5a1076e7c577bc90a28488fe7c29e4f9e1104ace9
pubkey2=0326d59594f931d05bab66abd65f4c0bcac2a69022f253d8dec162945e6ca35f4f
pubkey3=03a76d61c27cd4dda30997244382cf85144da528efe84a49e421d1e46fbf3796f2

Create multisig (2 of 3)
bitcoin-cli -signet -named -rpcwallet=aaron-leeb addmultisigaddress nrequired=2 keys='["020965eff1b66b3eb19dc070c5a1076e7c577bc90a28488fe7c29e4f9e1104ace9","0326d59594f931d05bab66abd65f4c0bcac2a69022f253d8dec162945e6ca35f4f","03a76d61c27cd4dda30997244382cf85144da528efe84a49e421d1e46fbf3796f2"]'

{
  "address": "2MyKvzJTM5awfC2waUq9c8GyxJVfjQaSr71",
  "redeemScript": "5221020965eff1b66b3eb19dc070c5a1076e7c577bc90a28488fe7c29e4f9e1104ace9210326d59594f931d05bab66abd65f4c0bcac2a69022f253d8dec162945e6ca35f4f2103a76d61c27cd4dda30997244382cf85144da528efe84a49e421d1e46fbf3796f253ae",
  "descriptor": "sh(multi(2,020965eff1b66b3eb19dc070c5a1076e7c577bc90a28488fe7c29e4f9e1104ace9,0326d59594f931d05bab66abd65f4c0bcac2a69022f253d8dec162945e6ca35f4f,03a76d61c27cd4dda30997244382cf85144da528efe84a49e421d1e46fbf3796f2))#gv350430"
}

I didn't add the multisig to my wallet so I had to view it with this command
to get the txid and blockhash.
bitcoin-cli -signet scantxoutset start '["addr(2MyKvzJTM5awfC2waUq9c8GyxJVfjQaSr71)"]'

Get coinbase txid
bitcoin-cli -signet getblock 00000002657d97ecb5658e7446d041d13315d83a6c434b2579be362a42ee44d7 2 | jq -r '.tx[0] | .txid'

6)
Create the psbt
bitcoin-cli -signet createpsbt \
'[{"txid":"08b68984f7d11e6ad64a9e4ce52649c3ab9ce3b0e6c822e98a80c08cdd8205be","vout":1092}]' \
'[{"tb1qddpcyus3u603n63lk7m5epjllgexc24vj5ltp7":0.00005000},{"2MyKvzJTM5awfC2waUq9c8GyxJVfjQaSr71":0.00344000}]'

psbt=cHNidP8BAHICAAAAAb4Fgt2MwICK6SLI5rDjnKvDSSblTJ5K1moe0feEibYIRAQAAAD9////AogTAAAAAAAAFgAUa0OCchHmnxnqP7e3TIZf+jJsKqzAPwUAAAAAABepFEK0pNV6wQBnfBdAjpA/0DX+PluuhwAAAAAAAAAA

Update psbt with valuable information for other signers
bitcoin-cli -signet utxoupdatepsbt $PSBT '["sh(multi(2,020965eff1b66b3eb19dc070c5a1076e7c577bc90a28488fe7c29e4f9e1104ace9,0326d59594f931d05bab66abd65f4c0bcac2a69022f253d8dec162945e6ca35f4f,03a76d61c27cd4dda30997244382cf85144da528efe84a49e421d1e46fbf3796f2))#gv350430"]'

Process psbt
bitcoin-cli -signet -rpcwallet=aaron-leeb walletprocesspsbt cHNidP8BAHICAAAAAb4Fgt2MwICK6SLI5rDjnKvDSSblTJ5K1moe0feEibYIRAQAAAD9

Updated psbt with redeemscript and history


add ^^ to:
bitcoin-cli -signet -rpcwallet=aaron-leeb walletprocesspsbt $psbt



Send raw transaction
bitcoin-cli -signet sendrawtransaction "hex"
